name: sandhi
description: SIH26004 — AI-assisted early detection of osteoarthritis risk markers for the North-Eastern Region

scripts.sync-artifacts: cp ml/out/model.json ml/out/metrics.json ml/out/cohort.json web/public/data/ && cp data/districts.json web/public/data/
scripts.parity: cd web && npx tsc -p tsconfig.parity.json && printf '{"type":"module"}' > .parity/package.json && cd .. && node tools/parity_check.mjs
scripts.build: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run train && npm run parity && npm run sync-artifacts
